descriptionByLocale.en:
Team leader in the hotel industry - housekeeping (m/f/d) 100% operations I hotel industry I housekeeping
• Your tasks Operational management of the team and periodic employee discussions as part of MAG holiday planning Further development and goal-oriented leadership of the team Conducting internal training Ordering and issuing consumables Active cooperation and organization as well as coordination of tasks Mutual representation with other team leaders in the department Accompanying and independent management of smaller projects Consistently demanding and adhering to the applicable requirements Hygiene guidelines, processes, occupational safety and quality standards
• Your profile Completed training as a housekeeping specialist EFZ and existing management experience Excellent willingness to provide service and a balanced, socially competent personality High quality awareness Structured and independent way of working Very good knowledge of German, level C1 (written and oral), any other language is an advantage Well-groomed appearance and very good manners Flexibility, resilience and absolute reliability are a prerequisite IT knowledge (MS Office, PEP)
